e7c3d20e-4b13-560b-b8ee-c5abca8cc624.correctness: 95.0% NaCl purity differs from 85.5% NaCl recovery and 90% gross mass recovery. ASA synthesis is atom balanced, SA limits, theoretical0.30000579g. e7c3d20e-4b13-560b-b8ee-c5abca8cc624.energy_path: No claim of catalyst changing equilibrium stoichiometry or reaction energy. Phosphoric acid is catalytic; no energy calculation is certified. Changes in storage/analysis time concern hydrolysis, with matched controls.
e7c3d20e-4b13-560b-b8ee-c5abca8cc624.independent_performance: Own weighing, reaction, filtration, washing, recrystallisation, mass-constant drying, Fe(III) series and melting comparisons must be performed and recorded in future. e7c3d20e-4b13-560b-b8ee-c5abca8cc624.representations: Actual colour and melting observations support limited inference, not exhaustive assay. e7c3d20e-4b13-560b-b8ee-c5abca8cc624.experiment_safety: Supervised SekII hood experiment; concentrated additions/quench by supervisor after cooling, open clamped vessel, flame-free baths, splash protection, suction checks and separated wastes. Local risk assessment is required before real use. Standards, solvent blank, pure-ASA negative, SA positive, duplicate timed equal aliquots, matrix spike and invalidation conditions are explicit.
e7c3d20e-4b13-560b-b8ee-c5abca8cc624.transfer: Extra dissolved sugar defeats evaporation selectivity. Damp storage versus older assay solution is resolved by same-batch dry/damp comparisons and fresh time-matched references, with independent practical tests and honest possible no-effect results.
e7c3d20e-4b13-560b-b8ee-c5abca8cc624.evaluation: Method specificity and uncertainty are bounded to free SA in the known ASA/SA matrix. e7c3d20e-4b13-560b-b8ee-c5abca8cc624.decision: keep; current full profile includes all seven expectations, two complete cases and a future practical acquisition route. none recommends no scientific profile rewrite; E0 author envelope has not itself supplied a P approval.
